name: Paseo CLI
description: Install Paseo CLI - local-first AI development environment with daemon, web UI, and agent orchestration.

version.description: Version of Paseo CLI to install

plugins.description: Comma-separated list of Paseo plugins to install on the daemon at runtime. Each entry is passed to `paseo plugin add` (Git sources like `owner/repository`, `owner/monorepo:plugins/x`, `https://gitlab.com/group/repo.git --ref main`) or `paseo plugin install` (local paths starting with `/` or `.`). Install requires a running daemon; call the generated `/usr/local/bin/paseo-plugins-sync` from postStartCommand.

enablePlugins.description: Enable the daemon-wide `pluginsEnabled` switch in config.json so configured plugins run. Setting `plugins` implies consent; set to `false` to leave the switch untouched.
